title: Level 2 data with API
author: Evilpostman
selftext:
Hello all!   
Looking for input from you all on this, I’m looking for real time level 2 data that my bot can scalp. I have alpaca pro and it’s seeing info there but I feel like it’s still delayed a bit and I’ve made the bot quick to execute orders but I feel like I’m still behind. My next step is to see if I should get the upgraded databento plan but that’s almost 3k a month for live level 2 data. Just seeing what you all are using. 

Thanks in advance y’all!

comments.author: Private_Tank
comments.body: If you need the data that fast, arent you trading margins so small that fees will eat you up?

replies.author: Evilpostman
replies.body: Not really, I haven’t seen any fees on alpaca for my trades.

comments.author: Initial_Republic5699
comments.body: Open an IBRK Pro account and transfer at least $600 so you're able to subscribe to their monthly market data subscription . You're able to choose what level 1, level 2 data you want. I pay $55 monthly for the data I need

replies.author: baldden
replies.body: L2 free if u pay commission more then \~ $30

replies.author: Evilpostman
replies.body: Ok I’ve seen IBRK come up too, are you guys satisfied with it? Hope the commissions don’t eat up my margins up a ton but haven’t looked too much into it.

replies.author: baldden
replies.body: Ai trading not working, don’t wast time 😀😁

replies.author: d_e_g_m
replies.body: Schwab give L2 with no fee

replies.author: d_e_g_m
replies.body: Well, the not real level 2 is working fine with me

comments.author: tearsofbears
comments.body: Databento does provide really fast ticks, I had my system is in golang it is able to handle it on a 6 core machine with some other things running as well. C,C++ probably will be better. I hope you are not using python.

replies.author: tearsofbears
replies.body:
I don't think python will be able to handle so many ticks, I assume you are using your laptop or something. Even with high end machines I don't think anyone does that. So probably your system needs to be better. 

I have a CS degree from a top university. If I were you I would first measure how good my system is doing and how much it takes to process so much data and decide.

Also, if you are subscribing to just one instrument like the index or just a few, you might not be in a problematic case. And your python setup might work.

replies.author: Evilpostman
replies.body: That’s good to know. I was wondering that too, if it was just processing too much information at once and when it would eventually see a good order flow, it was jumping in too late and buying at the top. Would you recommend a smaller pool of candidates or a better filtering logic for this to work?

replies.author: tearsofbears
replies.body: Both should help but I suggest if you can change the language and optimise your code you will be able to get the best system and also lower latency. But if you are subscribing to all instruments, in that case smaller pool should help the most but that would mean you miss setups from some instruments. I am able to work with \~400 instruments in my 6 core mac.

replies.author: Evilpostman
replies.body: That’s a good call I was even thinking of switching to under 100 tickers, ones with high volumes, then scalping those. Then rotating that 100 every hour or so. I may try that next week to close out this week and have data for the week to carry over for next. Thank you! I appreciate it! If you come across anything else that works for you, please share. It’s hard finding honest feedback in this sub that isn’t someone selling you something, so thank you!

comments.author: Ok_Doughnut_189
comments.body: I’ve been using massive API along with an IBRK pro account and their market data for level 2

replies.author: Evilpostman
replies.body: Has it been successful? And what is your strategy if you don’t mind me asking?

replies.author: Ok_Doughnut_189
replies.body: Still in progress and I’m building something that requires multiple strategies so I’m focusing on studying the mechanisms that move price. To early to tell I’m probably 3-6 months away from what I would consider successful also using IBKR to capture depth etc to develop even better strategies in a couple of months. Kind of a rookie to this but id say it’s going Great.

replies.author: Evilpostman
replies.body: That’s great! I’d love to touch base in a couple months and see how you’re doing and share results. I’m a bit of a rookie to all this too but it’s been fun for sure.

comments.author: bmcgin01
comments.body: TradeStation has great Level 2 from their API for a small fee.  Well worth it.

replies.author: Evilpostman
replies.body: Very good to know! Thank you! And there isn’t any delays?

replies.author: bmcgin01
replies.body:
It's a lot faster than the rest of their streaming data.  I have not done a study to check ms delays.  

TradeStation has the only Level 2 data I can find that's reasonable.    
\- IBKR looks decent until it's necessary to 2FA each day to use it.  
\- Schwab's Level 2 data is fake.  It's really Level 1 data from all their data feeds.

If there's another place to go in the same price range, I'd like to know too.
